text:
You need a Chrome extension that watches Tidio messages, sends them to ChatGPT on demand, and fills the messenger textbox with the AI reply for review before sending.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I’ve built browser extensions before, including a Clipboard sync browser extension for Clipboardly: a Chrome extension that synced saved snippets across devices through a small Express API, and it reached 9k weekly active users with a 4.7 store rating.

For your project, I can build the Chrome extension flow for monitoring Tidio messages, triggering ChatGPT API calls, and auto-populating the reply box cleanly and reliably. If you want, I can help design the extension architecture and messaging flow so it stays fast and easy to use.
